name: JavaScript
note: The only language on this page that can be run where it is written. The drawer underneath evaluates it, captures what it logs, and prints what it returns. Everything else here is written and read.
ground: Every generator in this yard is JavaScript run by node, and every one of them exists to refuse something: a quest that recurses, a faction with a gate in it, a building that shrinks when promoted, a form whose shape does not close. That is the house style — a generator is not a thing that emits, it is a thing that declines to emit.
ask: What does this refuse, and what happens when you feed it the bad case?
